correctness.rationale: Uniform simplex expansion of the sum and power-exponential one-coordinate CDF agree at order x^n and differ at order x^(n+beta). Their normalized signed coefficient is R_n(beta)-1 where R_n=product_{k=2}^n(1+beta/k)/(n!)^(beta/n). Log R is strictly concave with positive derivative at 0 and tends to minus infinity, hence exactly one positive root. AM-GM gives kappa_2=2, kappa_n>2 for n>=3. At n=3 the rigorous exact integer bounds imply 2<kappa_3<21/10<lambda_3. For beta>1 convexity and an all-components-large event give matching sum survival exponent -n^(1-beta); max survival exponent -C_n^(-beta). On the indicated interval signs oppose. Independent Python exact-integer checks of inequalities and bisection kappa_3~2.0629223972, lambda_3~2.191268131 corroborate (not replace) proof.
